From: office.manager@wellness-clinic.com
To: info@clinicverse.com
Subject: Mixed inquiries - multiple topics
Date: 2025-09-04T11:30:00Z

Hello,

I'm reaching out with a few different questions for our clinic:

1. We had a patient complaint about long wait times last week. The patient was seen by Dr. Adams on August 28th and waited 90 minutes past their appointment time. We want to document this properly. What category should this be filed under?

2. We're also looking for information about your document management system. Can it handle both English and Spanish documents? We serve a bilingual community.

3. One of our nurses reported that the automatic blood pressure cuffs in Exam Room 3 and 4 seem to be giving inconsistent readings compared to manual measurements. This isn't a formal complaint yet, but we want to track it.

4. We received a flyer about a new vaccine storage monitoring system. Is this something you handle or should we forward it elsewhere?

Our practice manager is Sarah Collins. You can reach us at (555) 456-7890.

Thanks,
Office Manager
Wellness Family Clinic
